ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation in the central regions of both lobes, transitioning to dense white mottling and irregular high-intensity flecks concentrated along the trailing edge margins and proximal lower sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees; depth is moderate relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most significant at the distal tips, becoming more uniform towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Composite curve characterized by a gentle convexity starting from the median notch, followed by a slight concavity leading to the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several high-contrast white circular clusters (~5-12 pixels in diameter) located primarily on the lower right lobe and the distal edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of parallel, thin high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the upper-mid section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly the left lobe, indicating significant wear or historical trauma.
